{"reason":"Add a high-confidence gate. v1 has 20 false arbitrations out of 28 (0.714) despite recall 1.0; six of the eight displayed false-positive rows have confidence below 0.70. Filtering those low-confidence escalations should materially reduce false arbitration while preserving the recall gate.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
